text:
monitoring-bot: [ALERT] notify-pager: external paging client in DRY_RUN mode for ~5m, pages suppressed. region=eu, impacted=external-pager-provider, error=client-config-mismatch link=https://internal.ops/alerts/1768904512
maya: saw this popup in the console, pages weren't sent but PD webhook queued.
sam: @maya are customers impacted or just internal test pages?
maya: live customers — 2 active customer incidents didn't trigger PD pages. we're getting reports from support.
ops-runner: digging — looks like a config flip in the deploy preview set `pager.dry_run=true` got applied to the running kube config. possibly rollout hook bug.
leo: i'm on-call, taking this. can someone add the customer ids to the thread? we need impact scope for pager escalation.
maya: customers C-4821 and C-9902 (both EU). support ticket ids T-17233, T-17234.
sam: timeline: deploy at 10:12 UTC, alert at 10:20, support reports 10:23.
ops-runner: repro command: `kubectl get cm notify-config -o yaml | grep dry_run` shows `dry_run: "true"` — expected `false`.
ops-runner: quick mitigation: patching configmap to set `dry_run: "false"` and restarting notify-pager pods. applying now.
monitoring-bot: config patch applied by ops-runner at 10:27 UTC, restart triggered for 3 pods. healthchecks passing.
leo: manual trigger to send missed pages to PD? we should backfill for the 2 customers.
ops-runner: created manual resend job: `POST /internal/manual-pager/resend` payload `{ "customer_ids": ["C-4821","C-9902"], "since": "2026-03-18T10:12:00Z" }` — queued.
oncall-bot: manual job succeeded, 2 PD incidents created and acknowledged by PD integration.
maya: confirmed support got notifications. customers acknowledged receiving pages.
sam: root cause hypothesis: config template generation for the preview rollout didn't strip `dry_run` override; config-sync pipeline picked it up during gradual rollout. filing follow-up in infra.
leo: immediate actions: 1) rollback safe-guard in rollout pipeline to prevent `dry_run` flips, 2) add a probe that verifies PD webhook acceptance post-deploy, 3) run a canary that actually sends to a dedicated PD test receiver.
ops-runner: opened infra ticket INFRA-2210 with logs and deploy diff.
maya: customer impact summary for postmortem: 2 customers in EU missed pages for ~11 minutes; no escalation delay beyond our manual resend; no production app downtime, only on-call notification gap.
leo: thanks team. we'll run an incident triage at 14:00 UTC and draft a short customer note. :thumbsup:
monitoring-bot: ALERT cleared for notify-pager at 10:34 UTC (suppression flag removed).
